title: No Determination | Unknown Disruption Code | APPR | Delay 6�9h (7h) | Basic Aeroplan
description: Flight AC 372 YUL?YYZ operated but arrived 7 hours late (6�<9h band observed in ADS/AODB). A disruption code IS logged in the system, but the code is UNKNOWN � it is not recognized or mapped in DDS and cannot be classified as Controllable or Uncontrollable. Passenger holds a Basic Aeroplan profile (9876543210) linked to the booking. Unlike FD-APPR-ND-04 (where ALL codes are NULL/missing and polling occurs), in this scenario a code exists but its type is unclassifiable � DDS immediately returns NO DETERMINATION (FD-APPR-ND-X02) without a 14-day polling window. Chatbot displays the standardized ND-X02 response and case is created automatically for manual review with a 30-day response commitment. Validates: (1) DDS correctly handles an UNKNOWN disruption code distinct from a NULL/missing code, (2) FD-APPR-ND-X02 is returned immediately (no 14-day polling), (3) Chatbot displays the standardized ND-X02 response message, (4) Case is created and routed to manual review without asking customer for confirmation, (5) AC Wallet is NOT offered despite Basic Aeroplan linkage � No Determination cases do not trigger payment flows.
